verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a dedicated testing/sandbox capability ('Simulate test purchases before going live' and a full testing guide) plus real-time authorization webhooks for auth-decisioning logic, supporting the core of the story. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents simulating clearings, reversals, refunds, or declines as distinct sandbox events beyond generic 'test purchases.' missing for 10: explicit documentation of simulating clearing/settlement, reversal, refund, and decline events in test mode, and independent/hands-on confirmation of full lifecycle simulation.
